dedupe_keys.name: mmodalfire a continuous multimodal dataset comprising video and physical sensing data for detecting indoor fires

description: MmodalFire: A Continuous Multimodal Dataset Comprising Video and Physical Sensing Data for Detecting Indoor Fires is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yang Jia et al. Because no multimodal dataset was previously available for fire detection research, we developed the MmodalFire multimodal fire detection dataset for training and evaluation of indoor fire detection algorithms. This publicly available dataset includes video and physical sensing data for fire detection use. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4929210010 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
